visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man and a young woman are sitting closely on a light beige sofa in a brightly lit room. The man, wearing a cream sweatshirt, is looking at his smartphone, while the woman in a pink hoodie has a laptop on her lap. Behind them is a large wall painting of Mount Fuji. (2) Suddenly, the woman turns toward the man and slaps his left cheek with her right hand. Her facial expression is one of shock and anger, while the man looks startled, holding his face where he was struck. The laptop remains balanced on her lap. (3) The woman then leans in toward the man, putting her arm around his neck and stroking his cheek with a dramatically apologetic and sorrowful facial expression. The man looks annoyed and pained, gesturing with his free hand while still holding his cheek. (4) The woman continues to comfort and apologize to the man, acting out a scene of regret. The man continues to express his grievance through facial expressions and hand gestures. Text overlays in various colors appear at the bottom and sides of the frame.

The video uses exaggerated physical comedy and vocal delivery to depict a girl's regret after realizing her boyfriend was on the phone with his mother, not another girl.
